source: hand-written from the sbx reference at https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/sbx/ (docker/docs commit 09d7cacc), the Docker Sandboxes release notes for v0.48.0 and the maintainer's daily use of v0.48.0; the argv shapes and the output of version and ls --json were checked against the help and ls output of sbx v0.49.2 on 2026-10-22, and the other output shapes are assumed where the reference does not give them, and block A re-measures them
description: Failure row 3 of 01 1.6: an sbx env run -d --clone never answers, and the timeout of its class ends it; the daemon may finish the create after romeu stopped waiting, so sbx ls --json then shows the sandbox.
